rules.note: Applies only to adult patients with severe hepatic impairment: recommended dose 50 mg every 12 hours.
Applies to patients with creatinine clearance less than 30 mL/min: dosing interval increased to 12 hours, with a maximum daily dose of 200 mg.
Do not exceed 400 mg per day of tramadol hydrochloride tablets.
Applies only to patients over 75 years old.
As-needed dosing is every 4 to 6 hours; the 4-hour lower bound is used as the minimum spacing, with 6 hours as the most permissive value.
